en.topic_title: Macau to hold closed-door trial in first national security case against democrat
en.topic_summary:
Macau will hold its first national security trial behind closed doors next week, a court said on Friday, in a case against a former pro-democracy lawmaker charged with “subversion”.



Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook.



The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a new bill passed earlier this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors.



Lawyers and rights groups have warned
